name.description:
This is the short label for the category as displayed in the documentation UI. It should one to a few words
spelled in title case ("Basics" or "Data Integration").

description.description:
This longer description will be included in the UI when the category is expanded and there is room for a fuller
description. The contents may be Markdown as described in {@link documentation-features.c3doc}.

baseTypes.description:
Any types listed here define membership in the category of types which mix in the listed base types. Note that the
base types themselves are not included.

typeSupplier.description:
A lambda that discovers which types are included in this category. This is used only if the type does not match
based on #baseTypes and #includeTypes. It will also be filtered by #excludeTypes.

excludeTypes.description:
A list of types that are explicitly excluded. If types matched by baseTypes or returned by typeSupplier are in this
list, they are _not_ included in the category.

includeTypes.description: A list of types that are explicitly included.

title:
Documentation on types and topics can be grouped into "categories" to make it easier to browse the large amount of
information in the system. Categories themselves are defined as metadata instances of this type.

Topics normally define their category using the multi-markdown syntax ({@link documentation-features.c3doc}):
```c3doc
Title: Authoring Documentation
Category: Basics
Abstract: How to author documentation for types and feature areas.

Platform documentation is produced from comments on types as well as separate topic files...
```
This will associate the topic with the "Basics" category.

Types may also listed explicitly in categories, but its better to specify them using relationships. A type
implicitly or explicitly belong to multiple categories. Types which mixin the #baseTypes and are returned by the
#typeSupplier are constrained by #excludeTypes and augmented by #includeTypes. If none of these fields are specified,
no types will be included in the category.
name: DocumentationCategory
